summary: Mama's Creations, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) to offer shares of its common stock in an underwritten public offering. The filing provides terms such as the public offering price and underwriting discounts to be determined, with the stock trading at $19.94 per share on Nasdaq under MAMA. The offering is conducted under an automatic shelf registration statement as a well-known seasoned issuer. Joint book-running managers include William Blair and D.A. Davidson & Co. This is a routine equity offering to raise capital and not a special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or going-private event.
